nina: Quick sync 3 final SEO checklist for the webinar landing. Need owners for KW mapping, redirects/hreflang, JSON-LD/schema, internal linking, and UTMs. Who can take what? :calendar:
omar: Ill do KW mapping + SERP intent table. Will deliver CSV with primary/secondary/longtail + recommended H1/H2 by Wed EOD.
jamie: Ill own page copy, meta titles, and internal linking map. Need omar's KW sheet to finalize CTAs.
kyle: Devs can own redirects + hreflang + canonical infra. If slugs change for locales we need 301s. Send final slug list by Thu AM.
tess: Ill handle JSON-LD (Event + FAQ + Organization). Tip: Event schema needs ISO startDate and stable URL. Will post sample JSON-LD.
maya: UTM and GA4 events = me. Proposing campaign id: webinar_launch_may. Will share tagging matrix and event names.
ops-bot: Reminder: staging window Wed 03:00-04:30 UTC. Any redirect/nginx changes must be in PR by Tue 23:00 UTC.
nina: Action items: [omar] KW CSV + intent notes (Wed EOD) | [jamie] copy + link map (Thu AM) | [kyle] redirect CSV + hreflang list (Thu AM) | [tess] JSON-LD samples + FAQ (Wed AM) | [maya] UTM sheet + GA4 plan (Wed PM). Tag this thread when done. :thumbsup:
